overview: Liberia is a country on the Atlantic coast of West Africa. Its capital and largest city, Monrovia, is named after US President James Monroe. Liberia was founded in the 1820s as a settlement for freed African Americans and became independent in 1847, making it Africa's oldest republic. In 2005 it elected Ellen Johnson Sirleaf, the first elected female head of state in Africa.

geography.text: Liberia has a flat coastal plain with lagoons and mangroves, behind which the land rises to forested hills and low mountains. It has some of the largest remaining areas of rainforest in West Africa, and heavy rainfall feeds many rivers flowing to the Atlantic.

history.text: Liberia was founded in the 1820s by the American Colonization Society as a home for freed Black Americans. It declared independence in 1847, making it Africa's oldest republic. Americo-Liberians dominated the country for over a century. Civil wars from 1989 to 2003 killed around 250,000 people, and in 2005 Ellen Johnson Sirleaf became Africa's first elected female head of state.

events.title: First settlers
events.text: Freed Black Americans settle at Monrovia.

events.title: Civil war
events.text: Two civil wars devastate the country until 2003.

events.title: Ellen Johnson Sirleaf
events.text: Africa's first elected female head of state is voted in; she takes office in January 2006.

government.text: Liberia is a presidential republic modelled on the United States. The President is elected for up to two six-year terms. Since civil war ended in 2003, Liberia has had several peaceful elections, including a handover of power to the opposition in 2024.

economy.text: Iron ore, gold, rubber and timber are Liberia's main exports. Liberia also has one of the largest ship registers in the world. It uses both the Liberian dollar and the US dollar.

culture.text: Liberia was founded by freed Black Americans, and its flag, capital (Monrovia, named after US President Monroe) and laws show American influence. It is Africa's oldest republic.

items.title: Providence Island
items.text: Where freed American settlers first landed.

sport.text: Football is the most popular sport. George Weah, the only African to win the Ballon d'Or, in 1995, later became President of Liberia from 2018 to 2024.

items.title: George Weah
items.text: Ballon d'Or winner who became President.

didYouKnow: Liberia is Africa's oldest republic, independent since 1847.
Monrovia is named after US President James Monroe.
